Workflows.description: Trigger emails or webhooks when bookings change.
Workflows.deleteDescription: This stops the trigger immediately. Existing reminders that have already fired stay sent.
Workflows.listEmpty: No workflows yet. Add one to send reminders or fire webhooks on booking events.
Workflows.upgradePromptAskOwner: Workflows are a paid feature on this workspace. Ask {ownerName} to upgrade.

ApiKeys.description: Tokens for scripts and integrations. New tokens are shown once.
ApiKeys.createDescription: Give this key a name you'll recognize later, then pick the scopes it should carry. You can revoke it anytime.
ApiKeys.scopesDescription: A token can carry at most the scopes your role grants. Pick the smallest set that does the job.
ApiKeys.revealedDescription: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again — losing it means rotating the key.
ApiKeys.revealedHint: Treat this like a password. Anyone with the token can act on the workspace within its scopes until you revoke it.
ApiKeys.revokeConfirm: Any integration using it will start getting 401s.
ApiKeys.noKeysEmpty: No keys yet. Mint your first key to authenticate scripts, CI, or third-party tools against this workspace.
ApiKeys.noWorkspaceEmpty: No workspace yet. API keys are scoped to a workspace — create one first, then come back to mint a key.
ApiKeys.upgradePrompt: API keys are a paid feature.
ApiKeys.upgradePromptAskOwner: API keys are a paid feature on this workspace. Ask {ownerName} to upgrade.

Webhooks.description: POST signed event payloads to a URL when bookings happen. Each subscription gets a unique HMAC secret, shown once.
Webhooks.createDescription: Pick a destination URL and the events you want to receive. We'll POST signed JSON payloads with an HMAC SHA-256 of the body in the X-Officehours-Signature header.
Webhooks.eventsDescription: Pick at least one event. We'll fan out a delivery for every matching booking action.
Webhooks.revealedDescription: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again — losing it means deleting and re-creating the subscription.
Webhooks.revealedHint: Use this as the HMAC SHA-256 key when verifying the X-Officehours-Signature header on incoming POSTs.
Webhooks.deleteConfirm: We'll stop sending events to this URL. Existing in-flight deliveries that already left the queue may still arrive.
Webhooks.inactiveHint: Auto-disabled — the receiver returned 410 GONE on a recent delivery. Re-create to re-enable.
Webhooks.noSubsEmpty: No webhooks yet. Add one to get notified when bookings are created, cancelled, or rescheduled.
Webhooks.noWorkspaceEmpty: No workspace yet. Webhooks are scoped to a workspace — create one first, then come back to add a subscription.
Webhooks.upgradePromptAskOwner: Webhooks are a paid feature on this workspace. Ask {ownerName} to upgrade.
